title: entitlement.v1 — Odoo tells an app that a plan is active or revoked
description: Delivered by Odoo app_entitlement's dispatcher to the app's entitlement-webhook after PAY1 settles (active) or a refund/cancel (revoked). Opaque references only. Signed per contracts/entitlements/README.md (X-Webhook-Source: odoo; X-Webhook-Event-Id = event_id).

event_id.description: ULID, unique per event; the consumer claims it once (replay is a no-op).

app.description: The paid app code. One Odoo PAY1 payment path serves all of them (TB-D1). A lowercase slug; valid iff it is listed in contracts/entitlements/apps.v1.json (the app registry is data, never a closed enum here).

app_account_ref.description: The app's opaque account id (a lowercase UUID, e.g. auth.users.id or a tenant id). Odoo stores only sha256(app:ref).

plan_code.description: A plan code configured in Odoo app.entitlement.plan, e.g. premium-30d. has_entitlement(app, plan_prefix) matches plan_code = prefix or plan_code starting with prefix || '-'.

status.description: active: grant or extend (valid_until only ever moves forward). revoked: the (app, app_account_ref, plan_code) entitlement ends now (refund or cancellation).
